title: Enhancing Argument Summarization: Prioritizing Exhaustiveness in Key Point Generation and Introducing an Automatic Coverage Evaluation Metric
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of argument summarization and introducing a new evaluation metric for coverage. While it utilizes datasets containing arguments on controversial social and moral topics such as abortion and gay rights to test its models, the core research goal is to evaluate summarization quality (coverage, redundancy, and conciseness) rather than to analyze or benchmark the ethical or religious frameworks themselves.
